operation.label: Trigger activation
operation.description: Activate a trigger and patch all affected downstream dependencies.

affected_closure.label: Name one target jurisdiction, one discharge pathway, the likely receiving water or POTW, and the primary permitting authority.
Obtain representative composite sampling, variability bounds, and mass-balance data for pollutants and residuals from the target waste stream.
Design and run a pilot with success metrics tied to the intended permit or pretreatment path and residuals disposition plan.
Choose between direct-discharge operator, indirect-discharge/POTW path, or channel/EPC/O&M model for the selected opportunity.
Convert the customer ask into a conditional LOI or pilot agreement with explicit compliance, schedule, and evidence contingencies.

Proceed with bounded diligence now: lock one candidate jurisdiction and discharge pathway, define representative influent and residuals, and structure only a conditional pilot or diligence-scoped customer commitment. Do not operationally launch or imply guaranteed compliance yet.
Named target jurisdiction, receiving water or POTW, and permitting authority are not fixed.
Representative influent composition, variability, and mass-balance data are not fixed.
Pilot-performance evidence on representative influent and residual handling is missing.
Partner path is not fixed across direct-discharge operator, indirect-discharge/POTW path, or channel/EPC/O&M structure.
Customer commitment is not scoped to diligence, pilot, or launch and therefore risks over-commitment.

required_approvals.reviewer: executive decision owner with regulatory/compliance reviewer
required_approvals.required_decision: approve diligence only, approve pilot only, or block launch until jurisdiction, influent, discharge path, and residuals plan are fixed.
confirm pilot representativeness against the selected regulatory path and target influent before commercial use.

required_approvals.reviewer: executive decision owner plus customer-facing owner
required_approvals.required_decision: keep commitment conditional and diligence-scoped unless U1 through U5 are materially resolved and G1 can be closed.

changed_decision_meaning: Trigger activation changes T1:trigger; 28 downstream object(s) are in closure, so the current decision rendering must be regenerated. human review blocks release.

semantic_patch_operations.effect: Activate a trigger and patch all affected downstream dependencies.
Route changed decision state to named reviewers.
Render a new decision view after validation passes.

patch_report.summary: trigger_activation on T1 affects 28 downstream object(s); transition=human_review; rendering=affected
next_steps: rerun validation after applying any object edits

collect required approvals: G1:executive decision owner with regulatory/compliance reviewer, G2:technical lead plus regulatory/compliance reviewer, G3:executive decision owner plus customer-facing owner
record trigger state change in patch history or review log
route through the required human gate before release
